scope: The criterion (Proposition 3.2) is conditional: it presupposes dominance of J, real eigenweights, and an integrable compactly-supported primitive; the unit does not claim non-vanishing for a general solvable group outside conditions (nC)+(nT).

The degree is l = rk_R(G) (the rank of the solvable factor in the Iwasawa decomposition); the p range is the author's 1<p<h/W_{n-1} for the interpolation Lemma 3.1 and p>h/w_l for Corollary 3.4, while Theorem A only says 'large enough p>1'. No claim is made for small p.

Theorem D covers only the groups AN arising in Iwasawa decompositions KAN of semisimple real Lie groups with finite center; the reduction to Theorem A lives in section 'ss - ss and QI' (L322) and uses Poincare duality and [BR], which are not re-proved here.
Vanishing in degrees above l (Theorem A(ii)) is not part of this unit: it is proved through [BR] and appears only as a cited input.

For type A_l with l even the author only obtains (iii'), i.e. at most one exceptional pair with beta+beta' in Phi (1296-1302, 1663-1670); the merged unit must be recorded with the relaxed condition and must not be restated as satisfying (iii).

The appendix (1980-2251) re-proves Pansu's theorem as an external standard input; it is a cited dependency of this unit, not an additional independent core and not a licence to claim the author's own mechanism.
Non-vanishing statements are about reduced cohomology where the author writes an overline (Theorem A(i), Corollary 3.4); the unreduced statement must not be substituted.
